final_user_goal: Establish a real forward evidence epoch from which future A-share research/execution can be certified without relabeling reconstructed pre-epoch evidence as prospectively observed.
hard_constraints: epoch T0 must be immutable and externally auditable
official current Mother Pool must be observed after T0 from SSE/SZSE
no security absent from current official Mother Pool can enter the forward Certified Universe
pre-existing frozen artifacts may be admitted only as an epoch baseline for decisions after T0
baseline adoption never changes their original first-observed timestamps
new current Mother Pool members absent from the baseline require fresh post-T0 issuer and locator resolution
removed baseline members must be excluded
filing content remains on-demand materialized under V2.7.30
no historical decision before T0 can use forward-epoch certification
soft_constraints_removed: rerun the full historical Mother Pool gate chain
rerun the full CNInfo catalog over all 5221 securities
require every baseline document to be re-fetched merely to prove the system possesses its already-frozen locator
make AlphaDojo coverage define official membership

architecture.Delete: No full catalog/PDF replay at epoch bootstrap.
architecture.Avoid: Current official membership is captured directly as a forward snapshot; no PIT reconstruction is needed for T0.
architecture.Absorb: V2.7.27 issuer map + V2.7.29 locator inventory become immutable Epoch Baseline artifacts for unchanged members.
architecture.Substitute: Only membership delta drives targeted post-T0 issuer/locator discovery.
architecture.Precompute_Reuse: Existing validated baseline hashes are reused; V2.7.30 materializes bytes only when consumed.
architecture.Optimize: Transport tuning only if the one-time current-membership observation or delta resolver proves necessary.
